contract: Selected D/E/F Termius-inspired UI prototype. 24 synthetic hosts, 12 initially open sessions. D is the resource library, E is the focused session, F is the task split view. No per-session top tab strip and no duplicated full host lists. No real SSH/RDP/VNC or secret access.

accessibility.evidence: Checked labeled buttons/forms, Ctrl K session search, Tab containment and Escape focus return in dialogs, read-only confirmation/input disabling, inspector Escape return, and reduced-motion handling. Focused prototype checks, not full WCAG or screen-reader certification.

responsive.evidence: The selected D/E/F views rendered at 1440x960, 1024x768 and 390x844 with no horizontal page overflow. Below 600px navigation is a dismissible drawer. Terminal content scrolls internally; task panes stack. VNC preview stays within short panes.

loading.evidence: Visible progress with cancel; cancellation returns to the current work area. Selected-prototype screenshot retained.

empty.evidence: Zero open sessions shows a useful choose-host recovery action; missing search matches show empty search feedback.

error.evidence: Specific connection timeout with same-view retry; simulated retry restores terminal. Checked readable light-theme error background.

partial.evidence: One failing host is named while other connection content stays available; no blanket success state.

success.evidence: Connected indicators, host selection, 12-session switching, synthetic terminal command handling, and focus/split restoration are checked in the selected D/E/F prototype.

permission.evidence: Prototype input policy: view-only mode disables input, names the target, and requires confirmation before enabling control. This is a frontend policy demonstration, not server authorization proof.
